comed: comer — eat! (imperative 2nd pl., -ed; comed, conde 'eat, count'; = comed)
deste: de + este — of this, from this (contraction; deste pan 'of this bread', partitive 'some of'; = de este)
saldredes: salir — you will go out, get out (future 2nd pl., syncopated salré with a d slipped in, old -edes ending; saldredes de cativo 'you will come out of captivity'; = saldréis)
cativo: cativo — captive, captivity (saldredes de cativo 'you will come out of captivity'; = cautivo)
veredes: ver — you will see (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = veréis)
comede: comer — eat! (imperative 2nd pl., variant of comed with a final -e; = comed)
penssedes: pensar — set about, see to (present subjunctive 2nd pl. as a polite command; penssedes de folgar 'take your rest', Pidal 'descansad, estad tranquilo'; = penséis)
folgar: folgar — to rest, take ease (infinitive; = holgar)
mê: me + he — me + I shall (circumflex marks the contraction, as lâ, lês; dexar mê morir = dexar me he morir, split future 'I shall let myself die')
partiendo: partir — dividing, sharing out (gerund; partiendo estas ganançias 'sharing out this booty'; = repartiendo)
muesso: muesso — mouthful, bite (Latin morsus; un muesso de pan 'a morsel of bread'; = bocado)
comedes: comer — you eat (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; si non comedes 'if you do not eat'; = coméis)
comiéredes: comer — (if) you eat (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = comiereis)
fijos: fijo — son (masc. pl.; fijos dalgo 'sons of something', noblemen; = hijos)
quitarvos: quitar + vos — to free you (infinitive + enclitic vos; first part of split future quitarvos e '(I) shall free you', e = he; = os libraré)
biva: bivir — may live (present subjunctive 1st sg., same form as 3rd; tanto quanto yo biva 'as long as I live'; = viva)
maravillado: maravillar — astonished, amazed (past part.; seré dent maravillado 'I shall be amazed at it'; = maravillado)
fóredes: seer — (when) you shall be (future subjunctive 2nd pl. of ser, Pidal's [ó]; quando fóredes yantado 'when you have dined'; = fuereis)
yantado: yantar — dined, having eaten (past part.; = comido; yantar 'to dine')
perdido: perder — lost (past part.; quanto avedes perdido 'all that you have lost'; = perdido)
canpo: canpo — field, battlefield (en canpo 'in the field, in battle'; = campo)
ello: ello — it (neuter pronoun; de ello 'of it'; = ello)
comigo: comigo — with me (con + migo, Latin mecum; = conmigo)
lazrados: lazrado — suffering, toiling, in hardship (past part. of lazrar used as adj., masc. pl.; = lacerados, 'hard-pressed')
pagando: pagar — paying, satisfying (gerund; ir nos hemos pagando 'we shall go on paying ourselves', taking our pay from what we seize; = pagando)
ploguiere: plazer — (as long as) it may please (future subjunctive 3rd sg., strong; mientra ploguiere al Padre 'as long as it please the Father'; si vos ploguiere 'if it please you'; = pluguiere)
santo: santo — holy, saint (masc. sg.; el Padre santo 'the holy Father', God)
pidió: pedir — he asked for (preterite 3rd sg.; pidió agua 'asked for water'; = pidió)
tiénengelo: tener + ge + lo — they hold it out to him (tienen 3rd pl. present + enclitic ge, = le before lo, + lo; = se lo tienen; 'they hold it before him')
diérongelo: dar + ge + lo — they gave it to him (preterite 3rd pl., strong, dieron + ge (= le) + lo; = se lo dieron)
comiendo: comer — eating (gerund; comiendo va 'he goes on eating'; = comiendo)
sobrél: sobre + él — over him, beside him (preposition + pronoun, the e of sobre dropped; sobrél sedie 'he sat beside him', Pidal 'junto a él estaba')
sedie: seer — he was sitting, he sat (imperfect 3rd sg. of seer 'to sit', unaccented -ie; = estaba sentado)
partiremos: partir — we shall part (future 1st pl.; with nos, no nos partiremos 'we shall not part'; = nos separaremos)
yantando: yantar — dining, eating (gerund; apriessa va yantando 'goes on dining in haste'; = comiendo)
aguardando: aguardar — watching, waiting for (gerund; lo está aguardando 'is watching him'; = aguardando)
bolvie: bolver — he was turning, plying (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié; bolver las manos 'to ply the hands', i.e. eat busily; = volvía)
guisados: guisar — made ready, prepared (past part. masc. pl.; de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go'; = dispuestos)
mandadnos: mandar + nos — order for us, bid (imperative 2nd pl. mandad + enclitic nos; mandadnos dar 'have given to us'; = mandadnos)
bestias: bestia — beast, mount (fem. pl.; riding/pack animals; = bestias)
dend: dend — of it, from it (variant of dent, de + ent; = de ello); in dend e the e is he 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the pleasure I have of it')
danles: dar + les — they give them (dan 3rd pl. present + enclitic les; Pidal danle[s]; = les dan)
palafrés: palafré — palfrey, riding horse (pl.; a gentle horse for ordinary riding rather than war; = palafrenes)
ensellados: ensellar — saddled (past part. masc. pl.; = ensillados)
pelliçones: pelliçón — fur robe, pelisse (masc. pl.; a fur-lined garment; = pellizas)
escurriólos: escurrir + los — he saw them off (preterite 3rd sg. escurrió + enclitic los; Pidal 'los salió a despedir', 'went out to see them off'; = los despidió)
franco: franco — free, exempt; also a Frank, i.e. a Catalan (adj. and noun; a guisa de muy franco, Pidal's 'juego de palabras' on the two senses 'catalán' and 'libre, exento'; = franco)
tengo: tener — I hold (present 1st sg.; en grado vos lo tengo 'I hold it to you in thanks', I am grateful; = tengo)
viniere: venir — (if) it come (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; si vos viniere emiente 'if it come to your mind'; = viniere)
emiente: emiente — memory, thought (noun, Pidal 'recuerdo, idea'; venir emiente 'to come to mind'; from Latin in mente)
vengallo: vengar + lo — to avenge it (infinitive + enclitic lo, -rl- > -ll-; = vengarlo)
viniéredes: venir — (if) you come (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; si me viniéredes buscar 'if you come to seek me'; = viniereis)
dexaredes: dexar — you will leave (future 2nd pl.; o me dexaredes de lo vuestro 'either you will leave me some of what is yours'; = dejaréis)
levaredes: levar — you will carry off (future 2nd pl.; = llevaréis)
folguedes: folgar — rest, take your ease (2nd pl. polite imperative/present subjunctive; = holguéis, holgad)
venirvos: venir + vos — to come (to) you (infinitive + enclitic vos, which belongs to the following buscar: venirvos buscar 'to come to seek you'; = venir a buscaros)
penssado: pensar — thought of, considered (past part.; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of'; impersonal; = pensado)
aguijaba: aguijar — he spurred on, rode hard (imperfect 3rd sg.; = aguijaba)
penssava: pensar — he set about (imperfect 3rd sg.; pensar de + inf. 'to set about doing'; penssava de andar 'set off on his way'; = pensaba)
catándos: catar + se — looking, glancing (gerund catando + se, with -se shortened to -s; catándos atrás 'looking back'; = mirándose)
aviendo: aver — having (gerund; miedo iva aviendo 'he went on having fear'; = habiendo)
repintrá: repentir — he will repent, change his mind (future 3rd sg., syncopated: repentirá > repintrá; reflexive with se, se repintrá; = se arrepentirá)
ferié: fazer — he would do (conditional 3rd sg. in -ié on the short stem fer-, as feremos; lo que non ferié 'which he would not do'; = haría)
juntós: juntar + se — he joined (preterite 3rd sg. juntó + -s(e); juntós con sus mesnadas 'joined his troops'; = se juntó)
conpeçós: conpeçar + se — he began (preterite 3rd sg. conpeçó + -s(e); conpeçós de alegrar 'he began to rejoice', the se belonging in sense to alegrar; = comenzó a alegrarse)
alegrar: alegrar — to rejoice (infinitive, reflexive sense 'rejoice, be glad', the se carried by conpeçós; = alegrarse)

__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain) · de + infinitive after an adjective (de ir somos guisados 'we are ready to go')
__broaden__.don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift') · also don — from where, whence (= donde, de onde; Castejón don abremos grand enpara 'Castejón, from which we shall have great protection') · 'whereof, with which' (Pidal 'de lo cual'; don yo sea pagado 'whereof I may be satisfied')
__broaden__.acordar: acordar — to take counsel, agree (infinitive; tornós a acordar 'he set to take counsel'; = acordar) · 'to bring (him) round, persuade' (nol pueden acordar 'they cannot persuade him')
__broaden__.mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping' · a mano 'by hand, hand-picked' (escollechos a mano 'chosen by hand') · dar de mano 'to let go, release' (Pidal 'soltar'; darvos e de mano 'I will let you go')
__broaden__.iva: ir — he was going (imperfect 3rd sg.; iva posar 'was going to halt'; = iba) · ir + gerund, progressive 'was gradually doing' (yas iva alegrando 'was already cheering up'; miedo iva aviendo 'was going along with fear')
__broaden__.tanto: tanto — so much, so great · tanto quanto + subjunctive 'as long as' (tanto quanto yo biva 'as long as I live')
__broaden__.quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as') · also 'how much' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'as far/fast as' (quanto pueden andar) · tanto quanto 'as long as'; por quanto … ha 'for all that there is' (por quanto en el mundo ha)
__broaden__.ir: ir — to go (infinitive; = ir) · ir + gerund in a split future (ir nos hemos pagando 'we shall go on paying ourselves'; = nos iremos pagando)
__broaden__.padre: padre — father · el Padre santo, God the Father
__broaden__.manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding · a las manos 'for the hands' (pidió agua a las manos 'asked for water to wash his hands'); bolver las manos 'to ply the hands', busy eating
__broaden__.grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had') · en grado tener 'to be thankful for' (en grado vos lo tengo 'I thank you for it')
__broaden__.del: de + el — of the (contraction) · also del standing for de + la before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel (del albergada = de la albergada)
__broaden__.o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?') · also o — where (relative adverb; o dizen Castejón 'which they call Castejón'; o el Campeador estava 'where the Campeador was'; = donde) · correlative 'either … or' (o me dexaredes … o … levaredes 'either you will leave me … or you will take away')
__broaden__.sol: sol — sun · also 'even, so much as' (sol non 'not even'; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of')
__broaden__.han: aver — they have (present 3rd pl.; = han); after an infinitive, the auxiliary of a split future (seervos han = os serán) · also han a + inf. 'they have to, are bound to' (mandado de so señor todo lo han a far); 'they hold, possess' (que moros las han) · also perfect auxiliary 'have' with a participle agreeing with its object (la ganançia que han fecha 'the booty they have made')
__broaden__.e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold') · also aver — 'I will', the future auxiliary in a split future (quitarvos e … darvos e de mano 'I will free you … I will let you go'; = vos quitaré, vos daré) · also the full verb 'I have' (el sabor que dend e 'the delight I have of it')
__broaden__.commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne) · also commo si + imperfect subjunctive — 'as if' (commo si escapasse 'as if he were fleeing') · commo que 'as one who' (commo que ira a de rey … es echado 'as one who has the king's anger and is cast out')
__broaden__.fue: seer — he was (preterite 3rd sg.; en buen ora fue nado 'was born in a good hour'; = fue) · also 1st sg. 'I was' (= fui; del día que fue comde 'since the day I became count'; Pidal: fué for 'yo fui' is still used in certain dialects)
__broaden__.aquí: aquí — here; d'aquí 'from here' · also 'then, at this point' (aquí dixo el comde 'then the count said')
